prediction_digest_scope: Expected prediction digests identify original valid-scores.npz file bytes, not separately hashed numeric arrays; no prediction arrays were opened to create this recipe.
purpose: Rebuild the already selected expert inputs; do not rerun model selection or original TEST evaluation.
scope: Fixed historical configurations, not a promise of bit-identical historical predictions under changed source or runtime.
settings_policy: Preserve embedded historical settings except selection_ndcg, which is an outcome and is intentionally omitted.
source_hash_policy: Preserve original recorded source hashes and separately report current-source matches. Mismatches require an explicit compatibility decision before claiming exact replay.
